The boss is an Arcana holder; it only spawns if arcanas are enabled, and the chest dropped by it only awards an Arcana.
All enemies on the screen are cleared. For every minute past 22, another Reaper spawns.
Il Molise can be unlocked by typing "relaxenjoylife" while in main menu.[1]
Unlike normal stages, the Reaper appears at the 15 min mark.

At the 9, 10, 11 and 13 min marks, the bosses spawned will always drops at least a one item chest. These chests can exceptionally evolve multiple weapons at once if the received chest is a higher tier, three or five items chest, which have 1% and 2% base chances to drop respectively.
Chests containing Arcanas at 11 and 21 min marks only drop an Arcana, however.

After 15 min, enemies are erased and the Reaper arrives. Only some gold pots spawn sparsely at declining rate. After 21 min however, the pots start to spawn at high rate until the end of the minute and cover the screen as the character moves. This is a great way to farm Gold as each pot is guaranteed drop one coin.
